defect_location.description: unique_lock 已持有时再次调用 lock()

trigger_condition: 单线程 unique_lock 重复 lock
notes: unique_lock 状态机误用：已拥有所有权时再 lock()。实测（WSL glibc 2.39）不是挂起，而是由 libstdc++/glibc 抛 std::system_error("Resource deadlock avoided") 并 abort（EDEADLK）。TSan / ASan / UBSan 均无报告 ⇒ 预期 miss。与 E110 同类：**一个让进程直接崩溃的并发缺陷对现有 sanitizer 资产完全隐形**。 【调和】原标注预期 catch，实测tsan未报告 ⇒ 按卡片「真实盲区：改标miss，在 notes 里说明」处理。这是**检测器盲区**，不代表缺陷不成立。

verification.detector_note: tsan 两档均无报告[-O0(rc=6) terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::system_error'   what():  Resource deadlock avoided timeout: the monitored command dumped core; -O2(rc=6) terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::system_error'   what():  Resource deadlock avoided timeout: the monitored command dumped core]
